arxiv-2004-13719.title: Leptonic Unitarity Triangles Preprint: FERMILAB-PUB-20-156-T, SLAC-PUB-17521
arxiv-2004-13719.creator: Sebastian A. R. Ellis, Kevin J. Kelly, Shirley Weishi Li
arxiv-2004-13719.description: Abstract We present a comprehensive analysis of leptonic unitarity triangles, using both current neutrino oscillation data and projections of next-generation oscillation measurements. Future experiments, sensitive to the degree of CP violation in the lepton sector, will enable the construction of precise triangles. We show how unitarity violation could manifest in the triangles and discuss how they serve as unitarity tests.

arxiv-2101-00760.title: Benchmarking Knowledge-Enhanced Commonsense Question Answering via Knowledge-to-Text Transformation
arxiv-2101-00760.creator: Ning Bian, Xianpei Han, Bo Chen, Le Sun
arxiv-2101-00760.description: Abstract A fundamental ability of humans is to utilize commonsense knowledge in language understanding and question answering. In recent years, many knowledge-enhanced Commonsense Question Answering (CQA) approaches have been proposed. However, it remains unclear: (1) How far can we get by exploiting external knowledge for CQA? (2) How much potential of knowledge has been exploited in current CQA models?

arxiv-2102-01676.title: Anomalous gravitomagnetic moment and non-universality of the axial vortical effect at finite temperature
arxiv-2102-01676.creator: M. Buzzegoli, Dmitri E. Kharzeev
arxiv-2102-01676.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by M. Buzzegoli, Dmitri E. Kharzeev. The coupling between the spin of a massive Dirac fermion and the angular momentum of the medium, i.e. the gravitomagnetic moment, is shown here to be renormalized by QED interactions at finite temperature. This means that the anomalous gravitomagnetic moment (AGM) does not vanish, and implies that thermal effects can break the Einstein equivalence principle in quantum field theory, as argued previously.

arxiv-2107-01053.title: Constraining the SMEFT with a differential cross section measurement of 𝒕 ​ 𝑾 ​ 𝒁 tWZ production at the HL-LHC.
arxiv-2107-01053.creator: James Keaveney
arxiv-2107-01053.description: Abstract A prospective measurement of the differential cross section of t ​ W ​ Z tWZ production with respect to the transverse momentum of the Z \mathit{{Z}{}_{\mspace{-3mu}\scriptstyle{}}^{\mspace{-1mu}\scriptstyle{}}} boson using a general-purpose detector at the High-Luminosity Large Hadron Collider (HL-LHC) is described.

arxiv-2110-14536.title: Connecting density fluctuations and Kirkwood-Buff integrals for finite-size systems
arxiv-2110-14536.creator: Mauricio Sevilla, Robinson Cortes-Huerto
arxiv-2110-14536.description: Abstract Kirkwood-Buff integrals (KBI) connect the microscopic structure and thermodynamic properties of liquid solutions. KBI are defined in the grand canonical ensemble and evaluated assuming the thermodynamic limit (TL). In order to reconcile analytical and numerical approaches, finite-size KBI have been proposed in the literature, resulting in two strategies to obtain their TL values from computer simulations.

arxiv-2203-16292.title: Put-Call Parities, absence of arbitrage opportunities and non-linear pricing rules Thanks: Contacts : lorenzo.bastianello@u-paris2.fr , chateaun@univ-paris1.fr , cornet@ku.edu . We wish to thank Simone Cerreia-Vioglio for very helpful discussions as well as audiences at Lemma, Paris 1, TUS-VII 2021
arxiv-2203-16292.creator: Lorenzo Bastianello, Alain Chateauneuf, Bernard Cornet
arxiv-2203-16292.description: Abstract If prices of assets traded in a financial market are determined by non-linear pricing rules, different versions of the Call-Put Parity have been considered. We show that, under monotonicity, parities between call and put options and discount certificates characterize ambiguity-sensitive (Choquet and/or Šipoš) pricing rules, i.e.

arxiv-2207-08660.title: Probing the electromagnetic properties of the Σ c ( ∗ ) ​ D ( ∗ ) \Sigma_{c}^{(*)}D^{(*)} -type doubly charmed molecular pentaquarks
arxiv-2207-08660.creator: Hong-Yan Zhou 1,2, Fu-Lai Wang 1,2, Zhan-Wei Liu 1,2,3, Xiang Liu 1,2,3
arxiv-2207-08660.description: Abstract In this work, we discuss the electromagnetic properties of the S S -wave Σ c ( ∗ ) ​ D ( ∗ ) \Sigma_{c}^{(*)}D^{(*)} -type doubly charmed molecular pentaquarks, which have close relation to their inner structures. Both the S S - D D wave mixing effect and the coupled channel effect are taken into account.

arxiv-2211-06090.title: A reasonable notion of dimension for singular intersection homology Thanks: The first author was supported by the research project ANR-18-CE93-0002 “OCHOTO” . The third author was partially supported by the Proyecto PID2020-114474GB-100 and the ANR-11-LABX-0007-01 “CEMPI”
arxiv-2211-06090.creator: David Chataur, Martintxo Saralegi-Aranguren, Daniel Tanré
arxiv-2211-06090.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by David Chataur, Martintxo Saralegi-Aranguren, Daniel Tanré. MacPherson intersection homology is also defined from the singular chain complex of a filtered space by H. King, with a key formula to make selections among singular simplexes. This formula needs a notion of dimension for subspaces S S of an Euclidean simplex, which is usually taken as the smallest dimension of the skeleta containing S S . Gajer employed another dimension based on the dimension of polyhedra containing S S .

arxiv-2305-12080.title: Record statistics of emitted energies − - prediction of an upcoming failure
arxiv-2305-12080.creator: Subhadeep Roy
arxiv-2305-12080.description: Abstract The article reports a numerical investigation of the breakdown of a disordered system considering the effect of local stress concentration under the action of an external tensile force. The statistics of the record-breaking magnitudes of emitted energies during the failure process as well as the waiting time to achieve those record events show rich behavior.

arxiv-2306-10737.title: Stellar spots cause measurable variations in atmospheric metallicity 2023 Stellar spots cause measurable variations in atmospheric metallicity – References
arxiv-2306-10737.creator: Tanner A. Wilson, Andrew R. Casey
arxiv-2306-10737.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Tanner A. Wilson, Andrew R. Casey. To accurately measure a star’s atmospheric parameters and chemical abundances, it is crucial to have high-quality spectra. Analysing the detailed chemical abundances of groups of stars can help us better understand nucleosynthesis, galactic chemical enrichment, and stellar evolution. In this study, we explored whether stellar spots can affect a star’s inferred metallicity and, if so, where the impact is the strongest.

arxiv-2310-01811.title: The Laplacian spectral moments of power hypergraphs
arxiv-2310-01811.creator: Jueru Liu, Lixiang Chen, Changjiang Bu
arxiv-2310-01811.description: Abstract The d d -th order Laplacian spectral moment of a k k -uniform hypergraph is the sum of the d d -th powers of all eigenvalues of its Laplacian tensor. In this paper, we obtain some expressions of the Laplacian spectral moments for k k -uniform power hypergraphs, and these expressions can be represented by some parameters of graphs.

arxiv-2310-09613.title: Combinatorial Group Testing in Presence of Deletions
arxiv-2310-09613.creator: Venkata Gandikota, Nikita Polyanskii, Haodong Yang
arxiv-2310-09613.description: Abstract The study of group testing aims to develop strategies to identify a small set of defective items among a large population using a few pooled tests. The established techniques have been highly beneficial in a broad spectrum of applications ranging from channel communication to identifying COVID-19-infected individuals efficiently.

arxiv-2402-11676.title: A Multi-Aspect Framework for Counter Narrative Evaluation using Large Language Models Content Warning: This paper contains potentially offensive and harmful text.
arxiv-2402-11676.creator: Jaylen Jones, Lingbo Mo, Eric Fosler-Lussier, Huan Sun
arxiv-2402-11676.description: Abstract Counter narratives --- informed responses to hate speech contexts designed to refute hateful claims and de-escalate encounters --- have emerged as an effective hate speech intervention strategy. While previous work has proposed automatic counter narrative generation methods to aid manual interventions, the evaluation of these approaches remains underdeveloped.

arxiv-2404-14938.title: Derived functors and Hilbert polynomials over hypersurface rings
arxiv-2404-14938.creator: Tony J. Puthenpurakal
arxiv-2404-14938.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Tony J. Puthenpurakal. Let ( A , 𝔪 ) (A,\mathfrak{m}) be a hypersurface local ring of dimension d ≥ 1 d\geq 1 and let I I be an 𝔪 \mathfrak{m} -primary ideal. arxiv-2406-07244.title: Collisionless shock in a relativistically hot unmagnetized electron-positron plasma
arxiv-2406-07244.creator: Kazuki Kamiido, Yutaka Ohira
arxiv-2406-07244.description: Abstract In this work, we investigate collisionless shocks propagating in a relativistically hot unmagnetized electron-positron plasmas. We estimate the dissipation fraction at shocks in the relativistically hot plasma, showing that it is sufficiently large to explain the observation of gamma-ray bursts even when the shock is not highly relativistic.

arxiv-2407-11804.title: A nonabelian circle method
arxiv-2407-11804.creator: Nuno Arala, Jayce R. Getz, Jiaqi Hou, Chun-Hsien Hsu, Huajie Li, Victor Y. Wang
arxiv-2407-11804.description: Abstract . We count integral quaternion zeros of γ 1 2 ± ⋯ ± γ n 2 \gamma_{1}^{2}\pm\dots\pm\gamma_{n}^{2} , giving an asymptotic when n ≥ 9 n\geq 9 , and a likely near-optimal bound when n = 8 n=8 . To do so, we introduce a new, nonabelian delta symbol method, which is of independent interest.

arxiv-2503-11139.title: A Comprehensive Characterization of Galaxy-Cool CGM Connections at z < 0.4 z<0.4 with DESI Year 1 Data
arxiv-2503-11139.creator: Yu Voon Ng, Ting-Wen Lan, J. Xavier Prochaska, Amélie Saintonge, Yu-Ling Chang, Małgorzata Siudek, J. Aguilar, S. Ahlen, D. Bianchi, D. Brooks, T. Claybaugh, A. de la Macorra, Arjun Dey, P. Doel, S. Ferraro, J. E. Forero-Romero, E. Gaztañaga, S. Gontcho A Gontcho, G. Gutierrez, K. Honscheid, M. Isha
arxiv-2503-11139.description: Abstract We investigate the relationships between the properties of the cool circumgalactic medium (CGM), traced by Ca II absorption lines, and those of galaxies at z < 0.4 z<0.4 by utilizing a galaxy-quasar pair sample compiled from the Year 1 data of the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI).

arxiv-2509-12176.title: From Autoencoders to CycleGAN: Robust Unpaired Face Manipulation via Adversarial Learning
arxiv-2509-12176.creator: Collin Guo
arxiv-2509-12176.description: Abstract Human face synthesis and manipulation are increasingly important in entertainment and AI, with a growing demand for highly realistic, identity-preserving images even when only unpaired, unaligned datasets are available. We study unpaired face manipulation via adversarial learning, moving from autoencoder baselines to a robust, guided CycleGAN framework. While autoencoders capture coarse identity, they often miss fine details.

arxiv-2512-01914.title: Uncertainty quantification in load profiles with rising EV and PV adoption: the case of residential, industrial, and office buildings
arxiv-2512-01914.creator: Aiko Fias, Md Umar Hashmi, and Geert Deconinck
arxiv-2512-01914.description: Abstract The integration of photovoltaic (PV) generation and electric vehicle (EV) charging introduces significant uncertainty in electricity consumption patterns, particularly at the distribution level. This paper presents a comparative study for selecting metrics for uncertainty quantification (UQ) for net load profiles of residential, industrial, and office buildings under increased DER penetration.

arxiv-2602-13162.title: New irreducible components of ℬ ⁡ ( 0 , c 2 ) \mathcal{B}(0,c_{2}) and Computation of the Dimension of its tangent space
arxiv-2602-13162.creator: Aislan Fontes, Maxwell Santos
arxiv-2602-13162.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Aislan Fontes, Maxwell Santos. We provide a Macaulay2 code for computing the dimension of the tangent space to ℬ ⁡ ( e , c 2 ) \mathcal{B}(e,c_{2}) in certain cases. Using this code, we identify components of ℬ ⁡ ( e , c 2 ) \mathcal{B}(e,c_{2}) containing singular points and compute the dimension of the irreducible component M 4 M_{4} of ℬ ⁡ ( − 1 , 6 ) \mathcal{B}(-1,6) , whose existence was proved in [ 7 ] .

arxiv-2602-14376.title: Event-based Visual Deformation Measurement
arxiv-2602-14376.creator: Yuliang Wu, Wei Zhai, Yuxin Cui, Tiesong Zhao, Yang Cao, Zheng-Jun Zha, [0.2cm] MoE Key Laboratory of Brain-inspired Intelligent Perception, CognitionUniversity of Science and Technology of China
arxiv-2602-14376.description: Abstract Visual Deformation Measurement (VDM) aims to recover dense deformation fields by tracking surface motion from camera observations. Traditional image-based methods rely on minimal inter-frame motion to constrain the correspondence search space, which limits their applicability to highly dynamic scenes or necessitates high-speed cameras at the cost of prohibitive storage and computational overhead.

pmc-11350545.title: Older Veterans’ perspectives on participation in a clinical exercise program: A qualitative study of the VA Gerofit exercise program
pmc-11350545.creator: Lauren M Abbate, Sarah R Jordan, P Michael Ho, Daniel D Matlock, Kelli D Allen, Sarah Wherry, Toby Wellington, Zach J Buxo, Vanessa Richardson, Courtney McGuire, Megan Pearson, Katherine S Hall, Kathryn A Nearing
pmc-11350545.description: Objectives:We explored the perspectives of older veterans in Gerofit, a Department of Veteran Affairs (VA) supervised clinical exercise program, to understand the factors associated with participation and how the program supported personal health goals.Methods:Twenty semistructured interviews were conducted with active and inactive Gerofit participants.

pmc-11400963.title: Nurses' perspectives on privacy and ethical concerns regarding artificial intelligence adoption in healthcare
pmc-11400963.creator: Moustaq Karim Khan Rony, Sharker Md Numan, Khadiza Akter, Hasanuzzaman Tushar, Mitun Debnath, Fateha tuj Johra, Fazila Akter, Sujit Mondal, Mousumi Das, Muhammad Join Uddin, Jeni Begum, Mst Rina Parvin
pmc-11400963.description: BackgroundWith the increasing integration of artificial intelligence (AI) technologies into healthcare systems, there is a growing emphasis on privacy and ethical considerations. Nurses, as frontline healthcare professionals, are pivotal in-patient care and offer valuable insights into the ethical implications of AI adoption.

pmc-11676753.title: Learning More May Not Be Better: Knowledge Transferability in Vision-and-Language Tasks
pmc-11676753.creator: Tianwei Chen, Noa Garcia, Mayu Otani, Chenhui Chu, Yuta Nakashima, Hajime Nagahara, Yanfeng Li
pmc-11676753.description: Is learning more knowledge always better for vision-and-language models? In this paper, we study knowledge transferability in multi-modal tasks. The current tendency in machine learning is to assume that by joining multiple datasets from different tasks, their overall performance improves.

pmc-12440634.title: Acoustic Analysis of Apraxia of Speech in a Japanese Patient With Nonfluent/Agrammatic Variant Primary Progressive Aphasia: A Case Study
pmc-12440634.creator: Narihiro Kodama, Akiko Miyazaki, Yuhei Kodani, Ryo Hatazoe, Kosei Hashimoto
pmc-12440634.description: Apraxia of speech (AOS) is a motor speech disorder often observed in the nonfluent/agrammatic variant of primary progressive aphasia (nfvPPA). While acoustic analysis has proven useful in identifying AOS features in English speakers, data on Japanese speakers are limited. This study investigated the acoustic characteristics of AOS in a 70-year-old Japanese woman diagnosed with corticobasal syndrome and nfvPPA.

pmc-12681947.title: Linking Premenstrual Syndrome With Salivary Alpha-Amylase Levels and Stress Levels: A Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-12681947.creator: Gabriyah Hamzah, Aryadi Arsyad, Elizabet C Jusuf
pmc-12681947.description: Objective:This study aims to analyze the correlation between salivary alpha-amylase (sAA) and stress in adolescents with premenstrual syndrome (PMS), and to assess the predictive ability of sAA levels and stress for PMS.Materials and methods:Sixty-two adolescents with and without PMS (31 each) were grouped based on their PMS status, measured using the Shortened Premenstrual Assessment Form (SPAF).

pmc-12750568.title: Pandemic shadows in the operating room how COVID-19 altered the risk and timing of surgical site infections: a multivariable risk assessment and time-to-event analysis in a cohort of abdominal surgery patients
pmc-12750568.creator: Fatimah Alshahrani, Ibraheem Altamimi, Ahmed Alhawamdeh, Sultan Alshehri, Mohamed Yaser Alquhidan, Saud Alhasani, Badr Alshehri, Mohammed Alshehri, Bassam Tarig Alkhuwaitir, Mohammed N. Alhuqbani, Samah Mustafa Adam, Rasha Assad Assiri, Hamad Ali Alyami, Nada Abdullah Alharbi, Thamir Saad Alsaeed, A
pmc-12750568.description: BackgroundSurgical site infections (SSIs) are among the most frequent and preventable complications following abdominal surgery, influenced by patient, procedural, and systemic factors. The coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic introduced new perioperative protocols—including universal masking, visitor restrictions, enhanced personal protective equipment (PPE) use, and modified operating-room workflows—that may have altered infection dynamics.

pmc-12860056.title: Epidemiological characteristics and spatial clustering analysis of typhoid and paratyphoid fevers in China, 2014–2022
pmc-12860056.creator: Huihui Xiao, Jin Zhao, Jinsong Qiu, Shuilian Chen, Yinzhu Zhou
pmc-12860056.description: BackgroundThe prevention and control of infectious diseases have become a critical issue in public health, especially after COVID-19. Typhoid and paratyphoid fevers continue to pose a threat, with outbreaks still occurring in many parts of the world, including certain regions of China.

pmc-12961193.title: Stable and functional regulatory T cell attenuates fibrotic remodeling in heart failure
pmc-12961193.creator: Takura Taguchi, Takuji Kawamura, Norihisa Mikami, Kosuke Torigata, Akima Harada, Lisa Fujimura, Emiko Ito, Maki Takeda, Kenji Miki, Shimon Sakaguchi, Shigeru Miyagawa
pmc-12961193.description: IntroductionHeart failure involves myocardial fibrosis and impaired cardiac function. The transverse aortic constriction (TAC) model in mice replicates pressure overload-induced fibrosis. Immune-mediated inflammation, particularly through T lymphocytes and macrophages, plays a pivotal role in the progression of fibrosis. In vitro–induced regulatory T cells (Tregs) are limited by Foxp3 instability.

pmc-13272382.title: Effects of a family collaboration care model on disease perception, self-management, and quality of life in elderly patients with multidrug-resistant pulmonary tuberculosis: a retrospective study
pmc-13272382.creator: Zhaojie Wang, Jing Pang
pmc-13272382.description: ObjectiveThis retrospective study evaluated the impact of a family collaboration care model on disease perception, self-management, and quality of life among elderly patients with multidrug-resistant pulmonary tuberculosis (MDR-TB).MethodsA retrospective study was conducted on elderly patients diagnosed with MDR-TB at Henan Provincial Chest Hospital between January 2022 and December 2024.

pmc-13388739.title: Engineering the future of advanced therapy medicinal products: a bioengineering call to action
pmc-13388739.creator: Giulia Nieri, Anna Spiller, Federico Stella, Alessandro Aiuti, Lorenzo Piemonti
pmc-13388739.description: Advanced Therapy Medicinal Products — cell therapies, gene therapies, and tissue-engineered products — are beginning to deliver on the promise of curative medicine: CAR-T therapies double survival in chemotherapy-refractory lymphomas, gene therapies reverse the natural history of spinal muscular atrophy and hemoglobinopathies, and Pluripotent Stem Cell (PSC)-derived islet transplantation renders type 1 diabetic patients insulin-independent.

pmc-13500852.title: Modeling network evolution by multi-agent reinforcement learning
pmc-13500852.creator: Dong Li, Tianwei Lin, Zhaoyang Bao, Bingqiao Gu, Yatao Zhang, Fei Yang, Yanhao Sun, Zhanwei Du, Petter Holme
pmc-13500852.description: Modeling network evolution is foundational for understanding and regulating networks. Existing models simplify away the fact that network evolution is often a group decision process, leading to two primary limitations: that nodes lack the ability to learn policy and that there is no coordination among node policies.

pmc-13678876.title: Real-world evidence for atezolizumab with bevacizumab for unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma: a multicentre UK Midlands cohort
pmc-13678876.creator: Richard Phillips, Harry Daniels, Marie Quinlan, Ali Suwaidan, Kaushal Maru, Jake Hancock, Mabel Teng, Jasvinder Kaur, Yuk Ting Ma, Sean Dulloo, Sadaqat Hussain, Basma Greef, Shivan Sivakumar
pmc-13678876.description: BackgroundThe IMbrave150 trial established atezolizumab plus bevacizumab (ATE/BEV) as first-line standard of care for unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), demonstrating superior overall survival (OS) and progression-free survival (PFS) versus sorafenib. Real-world data are required to further evaluate effectiveness and safety.MethodsWe conducted a retrospective multicentre analysis across three oncology centres in the Midlands, UK, with audit committee approval.
